lead.headline: Bad things won the footrace. Lap two is Drew Lock.
lead.dek: The team with four quarterbacks took Malik Willis, AB81 lost a starter, and Santa Clara’s Finest has until Thu 5:15 PM to get Lamar Jackson out of a slot worth 0.0.
lead.pull: Willis beat the quarterback on Bad things man bad things’ own bench by 0.04.
body: Yesterday I said first front office to the button gets Malik Willis. Here’s who clicked: Bad things man bad things, at 7:58 PM Wednesday, cutting Bryce Young. Then Ladd McConkey at 8:01 PM. Then the Chicago defense at 8:02 PM. Three moves, four minutes, and the league’s most active waiver team didn’t even need the waivers.

The funny part is the depth chart. The team that won the race for the wire’s best quarterback already had four of them. Willis projects for 17.79. C.J. Stroud, on that same bench, projects for 17.75. That’s a 0.04-point upgrade on the player sitting right there, and 0.71 on the one it cut. I can’t tell you why the front office did it. I can tell you what it did: the best quarterback available never reached a team that needed one.

It also paid. Bad things man bad things’ best lineup went from 160.37 to 164.05, the spread on Big Stric Energy went from 3.85 to 6.88, and its win odds climbed from 53.7% to 56.5%. For a team sitting at 29.1% to make the playoffs, Wednesday night was a bad night to be on the other side of that shopping cart.

Now the plot twist. AB81 moved first, adding Joe Milton at 12:15 PM and passing on the Willis call I’d been making for two days. That looked like the wrong quarterback for about three hours. Then Sam Darnold, its starter at 18.32 yesterday, came up Out with a quad injury, with Sleeper’s update stamped 3:00 PM. Milton is now in that slot at 12.53, and he’s only there because AB81 already had him. AB81’s best lineup fell from 161.89 to 155.42 and its odds against Cherry Blossom fell from 37.8% to 32.1%. Without that add, it would be shopping today with Stafford and two names who can’t play.

That opens lap two. Drew Lock, who plays for the same team as Darnold, is unrostered in R.A.T.S. and projects for 17.27, with a Questionable tag for his elbow. J.J. McCarthy is right behind him at 16.44 with no tag at all, and Baker Mayfield is at 16.22. Lock would beat Milton by 4.74, so AB81 has a real reason to go back to the button. Santa Clara’s Finest has a bigger one. Its 130.94 is still built with a 0.0 at quarterback. McCarthy makes it 147.38. Lock makes it 148.21.

Here’s the part worth circling. The Santa Clara’s Finest deadline isn’t really for the add. It’s for Lamar Jackson. His game kicks off Thu 5:15 PM, and if he’s still in that slot, he’s locked there. Pull him first and the replacement can wait until Sunday. I’d stop waiting anyway. Take McCarthy this morning, because a 20.5% underdog can’t afford another zero at the position, and let AB81 worry about Lock’s tag.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom is on both sides of tonight’s game
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom starts Trevor Lawrence at 19.63 and the Baltimore defense at 5.38, so its quarterback is throwing at its own defense. AB81 has Derrick Henry and Cam Little in the same game, which makes tonight an early down payment on that matchup. Big Stric Energy has the Jacksonville defense at 7.47, Maye I touch your TDs? has Zay Flowers at 13.95, and Santa Clara’s Finest has Bhayshul Tuten at 13.92 if his ankle lets him.

quick_hits.headline: Only the champ’s lineup is finished
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? added Tyler Allgeier at 1:12 PM Wednesday, the back I’d been pointing at Santa Clara’s Finest, then put Brock Purdy back in. Flowers took the receiver spot with Christian Watson at flex. Its 167.85 as set matches its best possible lineup, the only team in the league that can say so, and its odds against Poochinski rose from 37.2% to 39.6%.

quick_hits.headline: Young and Brissett came back to the pile together
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? dropped Bryce Young and Bad things man bad things claimed him. Bad things man bad things dropped Jacoby Brissett and Maye I touch your TDs? claimed him. On Wednesday both franchises cut the guy they’d picked up from the other, Brissett at 1:12 PM and Young at 7:58 PM. It was a trade with no trade and no winner. Young still projects for 17.08.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 is now a Philadelphia franchise
quick_hits.body: Milton gives AB81 five Eagles in the starting 11: Milton, Makai Lemon, Dallas Goedert, Darius Cooper and the defense. DeVonta Smith and the injured Jalen Hurts bring the roster count to seven. That’s not a stack. That’s a mortgage. It’s also why the Questionable tag on Smith matters more here than it would anywhere else.

quick_hits.headline: Sunday’s first lock is 6:30 AM, not 10
quick_hits.body: The week’s neutral-site game kicks off at 6:30 AM Pacific on Sunday, and it carries Ja’Marr Chase, Joe Burrow, Bijan Robinson, Chase Brown, Drake London and Tee Higgins. Nobody’s open calls hinge on them today. But anyone planning a Sunday-morning flex shuffle through those six should do it before the coffee, not after.

w9-m1.headline: The four-quarterback team pulls away
w9-m1.blurb: Bad things man bad things leads 164.05 to 157.17 at 56.5%, and every move Wednesday night widened it. Big Stric Energy needs Rashee Rice and Saquon Barkley, both Questionable, to play. It’s the most valuable upset on the board. I don’t see it.

w9-m2.headline: Still one quarterback short
w9-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins leads 165.27 to 130.94, with a 0.0 in the Santa Clara’s Finest number. A wire quarterback gets that gap to about 17 points. That’s a game, not a coin flip, and it’s still 79.5% deeboliciouskins.

w9-m3.headline: The champ did its homework. Poochinski still has more.
w9-m3.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? is set at 167.85. Poochinski is at 172.91 and gets to 178.86 by choosing Chris Olave over Chris Godwin Jr. Its 60.4% is down from 62.8%. St. Brown’s ribs and Watson’s tag are what could make this an upset.

w9-m4.headline: Cherry Blossom widens it without moving
w9-m4.blurb: AB81’s Darnold problem pushed this to 174.81 to 155.42 and 67.9%. Everything for the favorite still runs through Christian McCaffrey’s calf on Sunday, but AB81 now has to be right about Mike Evans and DeVonta Smith, too.

w9-r7-s0.headline: What will Santa Clara’s Finest do at QB?
w9-r7-s0.blurb: Willis is gone, but the wire isn’t empty: Lock at 17.27 with an elbow tag, McCarthy at 16.44 without one, Mayfield at 16.22. The bench has nothing. The hard clock is Thu 5:15 PM, when Lamar locks. I’d take McCarthy now.

w9-r7-s3.headline: Tuten’s ankle gets its answer tonight
w9-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten plays tonight at 13.92, Questionable. The listed Sun 10:00 AM is Skattebo’s clock, but the swap has to come before Thu 5:15 PM or Tuten locks. If he’s active, start him. Skattebo is 11.94, also Questionable.

w9-r4-s6.headline: Kelce’s tag makes Cherry Blossom’s first call harder
w9-r4-s6.blurb: Yesterday I said stay with Kelce. Today he’s Questionable with an ankle, and Washington’s 14.1 beats his 13.19 by 0.91, but Washington has to go in by Thu 5:15 PM, days before Kelce’s status is known. I’d still stay with Kelce, because Tre Tucker at 11.16 is a Sunday fallback.

w9-r4-s2.headline: McCaffrey’s calf is the week’s biggest open question
w9-r4-s2.blurb: Warren’s on bye, McCaffrey is Questionable at 22.74, and the bench has no other back. Clock is Sun 1:05 PM. He’s the difference between a comfortable 174.81 and a fight.

w9-r6-s0.headline: deeboliciouskins still can’t wait out Murray
w9-r6-s0.blurb: Murray is 17.17 and Questionable, and his game is Monday night. Mahomes is 21.19 with a Sun 10:00 AM clock. Waiting for the Monday answer means losing the Sunday option. Same call as yesterday, and the gap is now 4.02.

w9-r6-s8.headline: The Pollard slot needs a body by Sunday
w9-r6-s8.blurb: Pollard is on bye. DJ Moore at 12.95 is Questionable, plays Monday and leaves no fallback if he sits. Rachaad White at 10.66 is the safe choice. I’d take White with deeboliciouskins already a big favorite.

w9-r1-s4.headline: Big Stric Energy’s Rice call is a same-window problem
w9-r1-s4.blurb: Rice is Questionable with a hamstring at 15.69, Jalen Coker is 13.96, and both play in the same Sun 10:00 AM window. There’s a gap of 1.73 to give up. Get the inactive list, then decide.

w9-r1-s8.headline: Barkley’s hamstring and the Big Stric Energy flex
w9-r1-s8.blurb: Barkley is 12.81 and Questionable, Braelon Allen is 10.49 and healthy. For a team at 29.1%, the 2.32 points matter less than avoiding a zero. Sun 10:00 AM.

w9-r5-s4.headline: Wilson or McConkey is a 0.02-point question
w9-r5-s4.blurb: Michael Wilson is 12.96 with a ribs injury. New arrival McConkey is 12.94 and clean, and his game has the Sun 1:05 PM clock. If there’s any doubt at all, the guy Bad things man bad things just re-added starts.

w9-r2-s4.headline: Poochinski’s easy 5.95
w9-r2-s4.blurb: Olave at 15.39 for Godwin at 9.44, Sun 10:00 AM. Best non-injury call on the board.

w9-r7-s6.headline: Loveland over Henry, and sooner than listed
w9-r7-s6.blurb: Henry fell to 7.1 and he’s Questionable. Loveland is 11.06. The listed clock is Sun 5:20 PM, but that’s Loveland’s kickoff. Henry plays first, so make this swap before his game, not before Loveland’s.

w9-r8-s5.headline: AB81’s receiver calls are worth more than its QB
w9-r8-s5.blurb: Evans over Lemon is 9.4 points. Smith over Cooper in the flex is 9.69. Kittle over Goedert adds 5.43. Those three calls are the whole 24.52-point gap between 130.9 as set and 155.42 at best. Sun 10:00 AM for the first two.

w9-r3-s0.headline: Purdy’s back, and Brissett’s gone
w9-r3-s0.blurb: The formality got done: Purdy in at 22.31, and Brissett off the roster entirely.

2026-11-05-m1.blurb: Passed on Willis, which cost 5.26 projected points. Then Darnold went Out and this add became the difference between a thin quarterback room and a broken one.

2026-11-05-m2.blurb: Starting right away at 12.21, and all it cost was a quarterback projecting 0.0. Best value of the day.

2026-11-05-m3.blurb: Only 0.71 better than Young this week, but the best quarterback on the wire is now on this roster instead of a rival’s.

2026-11-05-m4.blurb: Re-added the receiver it dropped two weeks earlier. A 3.15-point upgrade on Omar Cooper Jr., and a real answer for Wilson’s ribs.

2026-11-05-m5.blurb: A streamer swap worth 1.65 points. In a game with a 6.88 spread, that’s not nothing.
